question.text: An open-ended Cat III AIF permits investors to:

answer.text: Redeem at pre-defined regular intervals as specified by the fund/PPM

explanation.text: The Logic: Open-ended Category III AIFs permit redemption at pre-defined regular intervals. The exact redemption calendar (for example quarterly, half-yearly or yearly) is specified by the fund in its Private Placement Memorandum. The Trap: Daily redemption and never/wind-up-only redemption do not describe an open-ended Category III AIF. Note: Distributors should confirm the specific redemption frequency for each scheme from the fund's PPM rather than assuming a uniform interval.
